title: Incorrect dunder method check in ChainableUndefined
detail: The condition incorrectly checks that the name does not start with double underscores while ending with them, causing legitimate dunder methods to be returned as ChainableUndefined instead of raising AttributeError. This breaks Python's internal protocol probing (e.g., copy, pickle).
note: Describes the planted flip in the dunder check.

title: Incorrect validation logic for __Host- cookies
detail: The function returns False for any cookie whose name starts with "__host-" because the first part of the return expression is `not name.startswith("__host-")`, which is always False for such cookies. This causes all __Host- cookies to be rejected, even when they satisfy the required conditions (secure, https, path=/, no domain).
note: Says every __Host- cookie is now rejected, which the planted `and` does.

title: Unprotected shlex.split on pager_cmd
detail: If pager_cmd contains unbalanced quotes or other syntax errors, shlex.split will raise a ValueError, causing the function to crash. This can happen when a user sets an invalid PAGER environment variable.

title: Missing timeout on subprocess call
detail: The temporary file pager invokes the pager program via subprocess.call without a timeout or error handling. If the pager hangs or crashes, the process may block indefinitely or propagate an unhandled exception.
